Mendon Capital Advisors Cut Its Holding in Shore Bancshares (SHBI) by $356,000 as Stock Value Declined; As Novo (NVO) Stock Price Rose, Motley Fool Wealth Management Has Lifted Its Stake 
March 12, 2018 - By Vivian Park 
Anton Schutz decreased its stake in Shore Bancshares Inc (SHBI) by 11.13% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mendon Capital Advisors Corp sold 22,250 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.70% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund run by Anton Schutz held 177,750 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.96M, down from 200,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mendon Capital Advisors Corp who had been investing in Shore Bancshares Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $234.48 million market cap company. The stock decreased 0.27% or $0.05   $18.48. About 13,584 shares traded. Shore Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ:SHBI) has risen 34.25%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 17.55% the S&P500. 
Motley Fool Wealth Management Llc increased its stake in Novo (NVO) by 13.92% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Motley Fool Wealth Management Llc bought 15,832 shares as the company’s stock rose 15.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 129,590 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $6.24M, up from 113,758 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Motley Fool Wealth Management Llc who had been investing in Novo for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $123.46B market cap company. It closed at $50.87 lastly. It is down 23.93%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 40.63% the S&P500. 
Motley Fool Wealth Management Llc, which manages about $130.00M and $1.17 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3,171 shares to 104,923 shares, valued at $16.17M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Paypal Holdings Inc by 17,146 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 589,841 shares, and cut its stake in Ultimate Software Group Inc (NASDAQ:ULTI). 
Among 15 analysts covering Novo Nordisk (ADR) ( NYSE:NVO ), 7 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 8 Hold. Therefore 47% are positive. Novo Nordisk (ADR) had 21   August 28,   The company was upgraded on Tuesday, September 13 by BNP Paribas. As per Wednesday, August 31, the company rating was upgraded by HSBC. The rating was initiated by Leerink Swann with “Market Perform” on Friday, August 28. The firm has “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley given on Friday, December 1. The stock has “Buy” rating by UBS on Tuesday, December 6. JP Morgan downgraded Novo Nordisk A/S (NYSE:NVO) on Friday, September 9 to “Neutral” rating. On Wednesday, December 6 the stock rating was upgraded by Bank of America to “Buy”. The firm has “Hold” rating by J.P. Morgan given on Friday, December 29. UBS downgraded the shares of NVO in report on Monday, February 8 to “Sell” rating. The stock of Novo Nordisk A/S (NYSE:NVO) earned “Equal-Weight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Thursday, September 1. 
By1 Vivian Park
